assertion_results.text: Step 0 extracts the Embargo policy URL from the Security Configuration as an optional field without raising an error (§1.71 — backward compatible extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md Step 0 config table: '| Embargo policy URL | https://example.com/security/embargo-policy (configured — Step 1.7 is active) |'. It is extracted with no error, next to other optional fields handled the same way ('Upstream Affected Component field | not configured (Step 4.3 and Step 7 skipped)', 'ProdSec Jira account ID | not configured'). embargo-check.md section 1 shows the step depends on whether the URL is present: 'Embargo policy URL configured in Security Configuration? | Yes ... Step 1.7 is NOT skipped'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 evaluates the CVE severity — CVSS 7.5 (High) meets the Critical/Important threshold (CVSS >= 7.0) and triggers the embargo warning gate (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: embargo-check.md section 2: 'CVSS score ... | **7.5**', 'Severity label | **High** (maps to Important)', 'Trigger threshold | Critical or Important severity (CVSS >= 7.0)', 'Comparison | 7.5 >= 7.0', 'Threshold met? | **YES** — the warning gate fires'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 presents a warning gate to the engineer including the CVE ID (CVE-2026-31812), severity level, a statement about embargo risk, and a link to the configured embargo policy URL (https://example.com/security/embargo-policy) (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: embargo-check.md section 3 gate text: 'EMBARGO CHECK — CVE-2026-31812 (High severity)' / 'High-severity vulnerabilities may be under embargo. Before proceeding, verify with your security team that this CVE is cleared for public triage.' / 'Embargo policy: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy'.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.7 requires explicit engineer confirmation (Yes/No) before proceeding to Step 2 — the gate is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: embargo-check.md gate ends with 'Proceed with triage? (Yes / No)'. Section 4: 'If "No": stop execution ... Do not proceed to Step 2.' / 'If "Yes": proceed to Step 2 (Version Impact Analysis).' Simulated answer: 'assumed to be "Yes" ... so triage continues to Step 2'. remediation.md: 'Embargo: High severity — gate passed (engineer confirmed).'

assertion_results.text: The embargo warning gate does NOT trigger for Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0) — it is skipped silently when severity is below threshold (§1.70)
assertion_results.evidence: embargo-check.md section 2: 'Because the severity is not Low/Moderate (CVSS < 7.0), the silent-skip path does not apply.' This states that Low/Moderate (CVSS < 7.0) CVEs take a silent-skip path, and the threshold is defined as 'Critical or Important severity (CVSS >= 7.0)'. No output contradicts this.
